title: Unscheduled blackouts and random loss: LTP recovery
summary: The contact plan says every link is up, but the emulator drops 5 % of datagrams at random on all four link directions and blacks out the Gateway-Earth leg from 40 s to 55 s and the rover-Gateway leg from 75 s to 80 s without telling ION. The rover sends one telemetry envelope per second (BULK envelopes are 3000 bytes, three LTP data segments) and answers PINGs; Mission Control sends a signed PING every 5 s. LTP retransmission is expected to deliver every envelope.

Checkpoints the rover resent to the Gateway (informative)
